spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  time AS "time", 
  cluster_metrics."mem_host_usagePct" AS "Memory Usage",
  name AS "metric"
FROM cluster_metrics 
WHERE name = '$name' 
  AND datacenter = '$datacenter'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

WITH ranked_vms AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY created_at DESC) as rn
    FROM vm_lifecycle
    WHERE datacenter = '$datacenter'
)
SELECT name, id, is_deleted, created_at, destroyed_at
FROM ranked_vms
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (name)
  datacenter,
  name AS "cluster",
  summary_total_number_vms AS "Total VMs"
FROM cluster_metrics 
WHERE datacenter = '$datacenter'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY name, time DESC;

SELECT time, "vmop_inventoryChange_numCreate_latest" as created, "vmop_inventoryChange_numDestroy_latest" as destroyed 
FROM cluster_metrics 
WHERE datacenter = '$datacenter' 
AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days' 
AND name LIKE '%$name%' 
ORDER BY time

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (id)
        name,
        id,
        created_at,
        is_deleted
    FROM vm_lifecycle
    WHERE datacenter = '$datacenter'
    ORDER BY id, created_at DESC
) t
WHERE is_deleted = false;

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        MAX(created_at) AS first_seen,
        (ARRAY_AGG(is_deleted ORDER BY created_at DESC))[1] AS is_deleted
    FROM vm_lifecycle
    WHERE datacenter = '$datacenter'
    GROUP BY id, name
) t
WHERE is_deleted = false
  AND first_seen >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')) * 1000;

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (id)
        name,
        id,
        is_deleted,
        destroyed_at
    FROM vm_lifecycle
    WHERE datacenter = '$datacenter'
    ORDER BY id, created_at DESC
) t
WHERE destroyed_at >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')) * 1000;

SELECT datacenter, SUM("vmop_inventoryChange_numCreate_latest") as created, SUM("vmop_inventoryChange_numDestroy_latest") as destroyed 
FROM cluster_metrics 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND datacenter = '$datacenter'
GROUP BY datacenter

SELECT 
  time AS "time", 
  cluster_metrics.cpu_capacity_usagepct_average AS "CPU Usage",
  name AS "metric"
FROM cluster_metrics 
WHERE name = '$name' 
  AND datacenter = '$datacenter'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time
